usedFor: Shopify holds products and carts, and Straico writes copy for them through “Generate AI Content”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Generate AI Content” in Straico
bestTemplate.why: A new product needs a description, and the action drafts text from the parameters you set.

watchOut: “Generate AI Content” returns AI-written text, so read it before it reaches a customer or a store page.
